page.title: Workflows
page.empty_description: A workflow defines the stages work moves through, including human approval gates. Ask a workspace owner or admin to create one.
page.disabled_description: An administrator can turn this feature on for the deployment.
page.empty_description_create: A workflow defines the stages work moves through, including human approval gates. Create the first one in the designer.

detail.no_version: This workflow has no saved version yet.
detail.used_by_empty: No squad follows this workflow yet.

apply.title: Apply to a squad
apply.description: Writes version {{version}} into the squad leader's instructions. Text the squad already has is kept; only the marked workflow section is replaced.
apply.no_squads: There are no squads in this workspace yet.
apply.preview_label: What the leader will be told
apply.labels_hint: The leader creates any that are missing the first time it needs them. Applying does not create labels.
apply.conflict_title: This squad already follows another workflow
apply.invalid_block: The squad's instructions contain a damaged workflow marker. Fix or remove it, then try again.
apply.members_hint: Applying also adds the agents and approvers this workflow names to the squad.
apply.members_empty: This workflow names no agents or approvers.
apply.member_unresolved: Not found in this workspace; it will not be added
apply.success_members_one: Applied version {{version}} to {{squad}} and added {{count}} member
apply.success_members_other: Applied version {{version}} to {{squad}} and added {{count}} members
apply.members_only_one: Added {{count}} member to {{squad}}; it already had version {{version}}
apply.members_only_other: Added {{count}} members to {{squad}}; it already had version {{version}}
apply.member_cannot_wake: Their comment will not wake the squad leader: the leader is private. Open the leader agent and allow this person under “Who can run this agent”.
apply.member_cannot_run: Work handed on after their comment cannot reach {{agents}}: those agents are private to someone else. Allow this person under “Who can run this agent” for each.

designer.legend: Dashed lines send work back for rework. Open the Definition tab for the exact text.
designer.cannot_draw: This version can't be drawn because its definition couldn't be read. The Definition tab shows the text.
designer.no_stages: This version has no stages yet.

editor.palette_hint: Drag onto the canvas, or click to add.
editor.empty_canvas: Drag a stage from the palette to start.
editor.saved_with_problems: Saved version {{version}}, but it has problems and can't be applied until they are fixed.
editor.conflict: Someone saved version {{version}} first. Reload the page to see it; your edits stay here until you do.
editor.invalid: The server could not read this workflow:
editor.not_allowed_description: Only workspace owners and admins can create or change a workflow.
editor.archived: This workflow is archived, so it can't be edited.
editor.unreadable: This version's definition couldn't be read, so it can't be opened in the designer.
editor.needs_wider: The designer needs a wider screen. You can still read the workflow as a diagram.

settings.title: Workflow
settings.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes the workflow's key and can't be changed after the first save.
settings.id_locked: The id is the workflow's key and can't be changed.
settings.description_hint: Used as the workflow's name in lists when it is first saved. Rename it later from its page.
settings.owner_hint: Who answers for this workflow (free text).

problems.title: Problems
problems.failed: The server couldn't be asked about this workflow, so there is no verdict right now.

yaml.hint_new: Paste a workflow's YAML, or load a file exported from another workspace or environment, then put it on the canvas and save.
yaml.hint_edit: Change the text, or paste a version exported elsewhere. It must keep the key {{key}}. Put it on the canvas, then save a new version.
yaml.label: Workflow YAML
yaml.applied: YAML put on the canvas. Save to keep it.
yaml.unreadable: The server could not read this text.
yaml.key_mismatch: This YAML has the key "{{found}}", but this workflow's key is "{{expected}}" and cannot change.
yaml.has_problems: This text has {{count}} problems. You can still put it on the canvas to fix them there.

versions.hint: Open a version to continue from it, or restore it to save it as the newest version.
versions.restore_blocked: Save or undo your changes first: restoring replaces what is on the canvas.
versions.opened: Opened version {{version}}. Save to make it the newest.

editor.key_taken: A workflow with the key "{{key}}" already exists in this workspace. Change the key under Workflow settings, or open that workflow and import this text there to add a version.

properties.id_hint: Used in labels. Changing it updates every connection.
properties.name: Name
properties.agent_hint: An agent registered in this workspace. Applying the workflow adds it to the squad.
properties.expected_output_hint: What the agent should produce. The leader tells it.
properties.approver_group_hint: Who may approve or reject at this gate.
properties.max_rework_hint: How many times this gate may send work back. A rework loop needs it.
properties.squad_hint: The squad this was written for. You choose the squad when you apply it.
properties.groups_hint: Gates use these groups. Pick people registered in this workspace; applying the workflow adds them to the squad.
properties.group_unregistered: Not a registered member of this workspace
properties.group_all_added: Everyone registered is already in this group.
properties.branches_hint: Every branch starts at the same time, as a sub-issue assigned to its agent. The stage ends when all of them are Done.
properties.branch_name_hint: Optional. Part of the sub-issue title; the agent's name is used when empty.
properties.branches_max: A parallel stage has at most {{count}} branches.

pipeline.refresh_hint: Read from the wf: and phase: labels the squad leader keeps. Refreshes every 15 seconds.
pipeline.empty: No issue follows this workflow yet.
pipeline.empty_hint: An issue follows it when it has the label {{label}}.
pipeline.no_stage_hint: Has the workflow's label but no phase label yet.
pipeline.conflicting_hint: The leader stops on these and asks a human to fix the labels.
pipeline.unknown_hint: The phase label names no stage of version {{version}}. The stage may have been renamed or removed.
pipeline.waiting_nobody: Waiting for an approver, but none is a registered member
pipeline.no_workflows: No workflows yet. Create one to see its pipeline here.
pipeline.empty_filtered: No issue of this squad follows this workflow.

rename.title: Rename workflow
rename.description: The name shown in lists and on this page. The key {{key}} does not change.
rename.label: Name
rename.conflict: Someone changed this workflow while this was open. It has been reloaded: try again.

lifecycle.title: Archive and delete
lifecycle.active_hint: Archiving hides the workflow from the list and stops edits and applies. Squads that follow it keep their briefing. You can restore it later.
lifecycle.archived_hint: This workflow is archived: hidden from the list, and it cannot be edited or applied. Restore it, or delete it for good.
lifecycle.archive_description: It disappears from the workflow list (Show archived brings it back) and cannot be edited or applied while archived. Squads that already follow it keep their briefing, and issues keep their labels.
lifecycle.conflict: Someone changed this workflow first. It has been reloaded: try again.
lifecycle.delete_description: All its versions and its history are removed, and this cannot be undone. Issues that carry its labels are not touched.
lifecycle.delete_in_use: These squads still follow it: {{squads}}. Apply another workflow to them or remove its block from their instructions first.

timing.title: Run timeline
timing.no_data: No timing has been recorded for this issue yet.
timing.parallel_saved: Run one after another, the parallel branches would have taken {{time}} longer.
timing.how_measured: Agent time is the work on the critical path (the slowest branch of a parallel stage). A person's wait ends at their first comment at the gate. Handoffs are the rest: the leader's own work and the gaps between steps.
timing.not_in_workflow: This issue does not follow a workflow.

insights.hint: Where the time goes across the runs of this workflow. A run counts when it began in the window.
insights.empty: No runs in the last {{days}} days.
insights.empty_hint: Runs appear here once an issue moves through the workflow.
insights.reworks_hint: times a gate sent work back
insights.bottleneck_hint: the stage with the largest share of the time
insights.truncated: Only the 500 newest runs in the window are measured.
